description.value: Hotel at the Waldorf is a retro, arts-forward hotel in East Vancouver known for its eclectic, no-two-rooms-alike aesthetic and a lively on-site entertainment complex including the iconic Polynesian-themed Tiki Bar and Howe Sound Taphouse & Kitchen. Located on East Hastings Street, it serves as a culturally distinctive base with easy access to Commercial Drive, Gastown, and downtown Vancouver. The hotel pitches itself as an affordable, casual alternative with a relaxed, spontaneous vibe.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms the OSM name, phone (604.253.7141), and address, though there is a postal code discrepancy (V5L 1S4 on most pages vs. V6L 1S4 on the contact page). The rooms page explicitly lists 'Free wireless internet' as a standard amenity, confirming Wi-Fi. The venues page confirms on-site evening food via Howe Sound Taphouse & Kitchen and the Tiki Bar. No mention of bike storage, bike-handling procedures, laundry, or any other cycling-specific amenities anywhere on the site.
concerns: Postal code discrepancy: OSM and most website pages show V5L 1S4, but the contact subpage shows V6L 1S4 — needs verification.

Booking calendar widget only displays years up to 2020 and the copyright footer reads '2014', suggesting the website has not been substantially updated; current operational status of all amenities should be verified.
No cycling-specific amenities (bike storage, tools, wash) mentioned anywhere on the site.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The hotel is a legitimate, operating accommodation but neither required WWC criterion (secure bike storage, staff bike procedure knowledge) could be confirmed from the website or OSM tags. Direct outreach is needed to determine whether it qualifies.

Nearby evening food.detail: On-site Howe Sound Taphouse & Kitchen (craft beer, pizzas, burgers) and the Tiki Bar are part of the hotel complex, per the venues page

wow_evidence: retro, arts-forward hotel in East Vancouver known for its eclectic, no-two-rooms-alike aesthetic and a lively on-site entertainment complex including the iconic Polynesian-themed Tiki Bar

price.label: Budget
price.signal: Explicitly 'affordable alternative' and 'budget conscious traveler' positioning, East Vancouver location, basic amenities, no premium signals
